purpose: Convert completed domain-source field extraction rows into an auditable queue for source-context fresh review, reusable card promotion, downgrade checks and model-admission blocking.

scope.selectionRule: Create one promotion task for every completed domain-source field extraction row; no row may enter calibrated modeling until fresh review and card promotion are complete.
currentLimitations: This queue is a promotion worklist, not evidence that fresh review has been completed.
No queued task proves a source supports intervention benefit, survival gain, effective-time gain or future option value.
All promotion tasks keep calibrated prediction, individual recommendation, individual death-date output, intervention ranking and domain-claim upgrade blocked.
The queue covers the current 81 completed domain-source rows only; long-tail domains still require separate source extraction and promotion.

queueDefaults.minimumPromotionQuestion: Does the source-context fresh review support, weaken, bound or reject this domain-source field row, and which reusable card should receive the result?

remainingWork: Complete source-context fresh review for each promotion task.
Promote supported content into reusable Source Cards, variable cards, endpoint cards, uncertainty cards and transfer-boundary cards.
Register downgrade checks for indirect, unsupported, overextended or source-context-mismatched claims.
Keep model admission blocked until promoted cards and downgrade checks pass later gates.
